question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlying word in the given sentence and complete the sentence.**

He was ______ by his brother’s attitude, but his mother’s words **__calmed__** him.
solution: The correct answer is **"agitated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Calmed" **means to become or to make somebody quiet or calm. (शांत हो जाना या (किसी को) शांत कर देना) • **Example**: *She **calmed**__ me.* • **"Agitated"** means to make other people feel very strongly about something so that they want to help you achieve it. ((किसी विषय को लेकर) आंदोलन करना) __ • **Example**: *They **agitated**__ for reform.* • This is the opposite of **being calm**. • The correct answer is Option 4. **Correct sentence**: *He was __**agitated**__ by his brother’s attitude, but his mother’s words calmed him.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Acquitted** means to be declared not guilty in a legal case. (किसी के निर्दोष होने की विधिवत घोषणा करना) • **Effaced** means to erase or wipe out. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) विलुप्‍त कर देना; मिटा देना या हटा देना) • **Solaced** means to comfort or console. (दिलासा देना) 3d:T6a4, The correct answer is **"Try out every possibility to get a result."**
